gold_points: Supply chain disruptions and reduced product availability from high customer demand
Temporary store and distribution center closings and reduced store hours for cleaning
Higher transportation, overtime, and cleaning/protective equipment costs
About $167 million in employee appreciation bonuses and increased hiring
output.note: The list of COVID-19 effects spans both chunks; the first covers supply chain, product availability, and closings, while the second covers costs, bonuses, cybersecurity, and inventories.
output.question: According to Dollar General's fiscal 2020 10-K, what operational and cost effects of the COVID-19 pandemic had the company experienced, even though it was classified as an essential business and kept stores open?
